text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well now, guess I'll take a 'zaru' today too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: If you're a true child of Edo, dipping just a tiny bit into the broth is the refined way to eat. Like this—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what the heck, my nose is...
...A-A... Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoaaah?! I dipped it way too much!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Like this, you can't even taste the buckwheat flavor or anything! Man, what a total flop...!
